neutral.description: Plain and clear, no particular flavour.
neutral.instruction: Keep the tone plain and neutral — no added warmth, formality, or brevity beyond what cleanup already does.

warm.instruction: Keep the tone warm and personable, as if speaking to someone you know, without adding content.

formal.instruction: Keep the tone formal and professional: complete sentences, no slang, no contractions.

terse.instruction: Keep the tone terse: the fewest words that keep the meaning, no pleasantries.
